Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_CRYO_ID
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 vcount number;
begin
 vcount := 0;
 select count(*) into vcount from cryo_units where
 cryo_worksheet_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_tb_id and
 (thaw_method is null or
 thaw_temperature is null or
 sep_ind is null or
 freeze_time is null) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 if vcount = 0 then
 show_error('1605');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1149');
 check_package_failure;
end;

Block.Name: CRYO_UNITS
Block.OrderByClause: order by freeze_time, sep_ind, thaw_temperature, thaw_method

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 v_local_time date;
 
begin
 :cryo_units.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:cryo_units.unit_id,:cryo_units.coll_date,
 :global.chapter_id);

 --MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if :freeze_time is not null then
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :freeze_time, v_local_time);
 :freeze_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :freeze_time := :freeze_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 --MS 


 select product_short_name into :product_short_name
 from valid_products
--HCLC where product_code = :actual_product_code;
 where product_code = SUBSTR(:actual_product_code,1,5)
 and unit_scheme_type = 'I';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
end;
